name: Keen's lightsaber
description: Keen's lightsaber was a yellow-bladed lightsaber utilized by the Jedi Enya Keen during the High Republic Era. Keen's lightsaber a metal knuckle guard sculpted into the hilt, a feature rarely seen in the sabers of other Jedi. A flared fitting was set just below the blade emitter to protect Keen from injury during lightsaber practice.
